No. 1924/2 – MONDAY, JULY 20, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No.: Biya/3/1/1/262/VOL I.
I, hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose.

Description of the lands to be acquired: Allotments of land in extent of about 0.1256 Hectare, depicted in the preliminary Plan No. Gam. 3959 was prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the village of Ihala Biyanvila, in the Grama Niladari Division No. 269 Ihala Biyanvila North, in the Minor Division of Adikari paththuwa, in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Biyagama, in the Gampaha District in Western Province.
1. Lot No. 1 Name of Land: Jambugaha Kumbura Owita; Description: Paddy Field; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: D. I. N. M. Negali, No. 08, Albret place, Colombo 03; Extent: 0.0121 Hectare.

2. Lot No. 2 Name of Land: Jambugaha Kumbura Owita; Description: Garden and a permanent building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Loren Marina Perera, No. 174/3A, Ihala Biyanvila, Kadawatha; Extent: 0.0142 Hectare.

3. Lot No. 3 Name of Land: Jambugaha Kumbura Owita; Description: Garden and a permanent building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: S. D. Jayarathna, No. 174/3B, Shramadana Mawatha, Kadawatha; Extent: 0.0322 Hectare.

4. Lot No. 4 Name of Land: Jambugaha Kumbura Owita; Description: Garden a permanent building, a toilet and a well covered by cement; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Vijayawala Weerake Edman Nilantha Kumara, No. 174/2, Ihala Biyanvila, Kadawatha; Extent: 0.0169 Hectare.

5. Lot No. 5 Name of Land: Jambugaha Kumbura Owita; Description: Garden and a permanent building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Nawagamuwa Dewage Deeman Athula Franando, No. 174/1, Ihala Biyanvila, Kadawatha; Extent: 0.0152 Hectare.

6. Lot No. 6 Name of Land: Jambugaha Kumbura Owita; Description: Garden a permanent building and part of a toilet; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: N. D. M. Chandra Kumara, No. 174/1, Shaimadana Mawatha, Ihala Biyanvila, Kadawatha; Extent: 0.0126 Hectare.

Claimant: State; Original Claimant: W. C. K. J. Fernando, No. 155, Station Road, Maharagama; Extent: 0.0223 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretary’s Office of Biyagama on the 06th August, 2015 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 03rd August, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars or their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the
said land the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
W. H. V. PUSHPAMALA, Divisional Secretary, Biyagama.
